tests.name: Continuous walk
tests.protocol: Walk continuously on flat ground at a comfortable pace. Pain stays 0-2, no leg symptoms, next morning no worse.
tests.safety: Run only on a day when yesterday's and this morning's check-ins are green. Stop at the first form breakdown or any symptom. A pass is provisional until the next-morning check-in is green.

tests.name: Workday upright tolerance (with breaks)
tests.protocol: On a normal day, accumulate the target upright hours while taking the scheduled breaks and decompression rest. Local pressure stays at 2/10 or less at the end of the day and the next morning is no worse. This measures function, it is not a challenge to stand without breaks.
tests.safety: Never stand without breaks just to pass this test.

tests.name: Pain-free dowel hinge
tests.protocol: 10 reps of the dowel hip hinge with head, upper back and tailbone staying in contact on every rep, no pain.
tests.safety: Run only on a day when yesterday's and this morning's check-ins are green. Stop at the first form breakdown or any symptom. A pass is provisional until the next-morning check-in is green.

tests.name: Box squat pattern
tests.protocol: L1: box squat with strap/counter support. L2: unsupported chair-tap box squat. No rounding at the bottom (side-view phone video).
tests.safety: Run only on a day when yesterday's and this morning's check-ins are green. Stop at the first form breakdown or any symptom. A pass is provisional until the next-morning check-in is green.

tests.name: Side bridge endurance (each side)
tests.protocol: Hold the side bridge until the hips sag or the cap is reached. L2 from knees, L3+ from feet. The two sides should differ by no more than 15% (10% at L8).
tests.safety: Run only on a day when yesterday's and this morning's check-ins are green. Stop at the first form breakdown or any symptom. A pass is provisional until the next-morning check-in is green. Cap: stop at the target.

tests.name: Bird dog endurance
tests.protocol: Reps of 10 s holds per side with level pelvis and no low-back arching (the cup-on-the-back test).
tests.safety: Run only on a day when yesterday's and this morning's check-ins are green. Stop at the first form breakdown or any symptom. A pass is provisional until the next-morning check-in is green.

tests.name: Dead bug quality
tests.protocol: 3 sets of 10 per side of opposite arm/leg reach with ribs down and the back flat on its natural curve (no arch).
tests.safety: Run only on a day when yesterday's and this morning's check-ins are green. Stop at the first form breakdown or any symptom. A pass is provisional until the next-morning check-in is green.

tests.name: Single-leg balance, eyes open
tests.protocol: Stand on one leg on a firm surface, arms folded or hands at hips. Each side.
tests.safety: Stand next to a wall.

tests.name: Single-leg balance, eyes closed
tests.protocol: Stand on one leg on a firm surface with eyes closed. Each side.
tests.safety: Stand next to a wall.

tests.name: Pain-free loaded hinge
tests.protocol: Perform the level's hinge lift for the stated reps, with neutral spine, RPE 7 or less, pain 0-2. L3 and L4: kettlebell from the block. L5: from the floor. L6: barbell from blocks. L7 and L8: barbell from the floor.

tests.name: Slow step-down

tests.protocol: L5: inverted row 3x8. L6: band-assisted pull-up 3x5. L7: 5 strict pull-ups. L8: 8 strict pull-ups.

tests.name: McGill trunk flexor endurance
tests.protocol: Sit reclined at 60 degrees against a wedge/cushions, knees bent, feet anchored, arms crossed; hold until the trunk drops from the line or the target time. Isometric only; pain 0-2.
tests.safety: Run only on a day when yesterday's and this morning's check-ins are green. Stop at the first form breakdown or any symptom. A pass is provisional until the next-morning check-in is green.

tests.name: Trunk extensor endurance (Biering-Sorensen style)
tests.protocol: OPTIONAL. Prone with hips on a bench edge and legs anchored, arms crossed, hold the trunk horizontal. Skip permanently if extension reproduces symptoms.
tests.safety: Run only on a day when yesterday's and this morning's check-ins are green. Stop at the first form breakdown or any symptom. A pass is provisional until the next-morning check-in is green. Stop at the target. Side-bridge average should be at least 75% of extensor time.
